test_modes.name: LoRa Alliance Certification
test_modes.purpose: Conformance to LoRaWAN L2 + Regional Parameters (join, ADR, MAC commands, RX timing, class behaviors).

test_modes.name: CAD test
test_modes.purpose: Verify preamble detection at low power.

spec_provided_observability.name: DevStatusReq/Ans
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Battery level and demodulation margin reported by the device.

spec_provided_observability.name: LinkCheckReq/Ans
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Link margin and gateway count reported to the device.

spec_provided_observability.name: RSSI / SNR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Received-signal strength and signal-to-noise of each frame, reported by the gateway/network server.

spec_provided_observability.name: MIC-failure / FCnt counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Integrity-failure and replay-detection telemetry at the network server.

spec_provided_observability.name: Channel Activity Detection (CAD)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Low-power preamble detection used to probe the channel.

notes: Observability is in-protocol: DevStatus/LinkCheck MAC commands, gateway-reported RSSI/SNR, and network-server MIC/FCnt counters. Conformance is established by the LoRa Alliance Certification program; chip-level scan/BIST is an integrator concern.
